cd repo && echo '== before: the bad commit' && git show --format='%h %s' HEAD -- deployment.yaml && git revert --no-edit HEAD >/dev/null && echo '== after: the history' && git log --oneline && echo '== the revert commit' && git show --format='%h %s' HEAD -- deployment.yaml
